thread:
Evan H.: Heads-up: deploybot failed final promote of build 2026.03.21-rc3 to eu-ecr — push rejected with provenance digest mismatch :confused:
Jess P.: Saw the alert. Do we know if this is caused by manifestlist ordering or CI annotations?
Evan H.: Error: `provenance: signed manifest digest sha256:abc123 != computed sha256:def456`
deploybot: action=hold -> reason="provenance-mismatch"; target=eu-west-1; tag=rc3
Laura K.: Can someone run `skopeo inspect` and `aws ecr batch-get-image` in both regions and paste outputs? I want the manifest bytes.
Mike C.: Quick check: us-east-1 shows digest sha256:0f1e2d3c (matches CI's canonical manifest). eu-west-1 reports an older manifest digest.
Jess P.: If it's replication lag we can wait; if it's a manifest-level annotation difference we need to pin or re-sign. Which is it?
Evan H.: Diffs are only in manifest annotations: `buildmeta.sha` differs (CI injected ephemeral value). Layers (fs) are identical. cosign validation fails because it signs complete manifest bytes including annotations.
Laura K.: Ok that makes sense. Options:
- pin tag to canonical digest and promote that digest across regions (preferred)
- allow a one-off provenance bypass (not acceptable for compliance)
- re-sign eu manifest to match upstream (requires KMS and audit entry)
Mike C.: I'm for pin-to-digest and propagate — smallest blast radius and keeps signatures intact.
Jess P.: Agree. Also prepare a short release note: "Promotion paused: manifest annotation variance across mirrors; tag pinned to digest sha256:0f1e2d3c; re-signing planned during maintenance window."
Evan H.: Doing the pin now. Commands (high-level):
```
# get canonical manifest from us-east-1
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-ids imageTag=rc3 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text > canonical-manifest.json
# put that manifest in eu region with same tag
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-tag rc3 --image-manifest file://canonical-manifest.json --region eu-west-1
```
Sre-bot: Note: manual put-image can create a new manifest object and may be audited; prefer importing original manifest bytes when possible.
Laura K.: Schedule a 10-minute change window at 10:15 UTC to run the regional mirror job and to trigger the KMS-based re-sign flow. I'll own the re-sign step.
Mike C.: Draft release note ready to post after pinning. Also creating backlog ticket to stop CI from adding ephemeral `buildmeta.sha` when promoting between registries.
Jess P.: If eu rejects the put-image, escalation plan: contact registry support and consider rolling back the staging canary. But try pin first.
Evan H.: Pin completed. eu-west-1 now shows digest sha256:0f1e2d3c. deploybot removed the hold and resumed canary promotions :thumbsup:
Laura K.: Great. Change window remains at 10:15 UTC for re-sign and mirror verification. I'll write a short postmortem note afterwards.
Mike C.: Release note to #general: "rc3 promotion briefly paused; pinned to digest sha256:0f1e2d3c due to manifest annotation mismatch across mirrors. Re-sign and mirror verification planned during maintenance window."
Jess P.: Follow-ups: (1) remove ephemeral manifest annotations during promotion flow (ticket created), (2) add automated parity check for manifest bytes across mirrors before sign, (3) update deploybot to detect annotation-only diffs and suggest digest import.
Evan H.: Thanks everyone. I'll add this thread to the release ticket and close once re-sign is done. :white_check_mark:
